entities.summary: Jaume de Prades i de Foix (b. 1341, Valencia) was a prominent entrepreneur and business leader of the Medieval period, shaping the economy and culture of Valencia through his dealings with religious institutions and cultural exchange. He played a key role in the development of the textile industry, with his company, 'Sociedad de la Lana,' contributing to the growth of Valencia's economy. His connections with the Catholic Church and the Kingdom of Aragon had a lasting impact on the region's politics and society. De Prades i de Foix's legacy can be seen in the modern-day textile industry, which remains a significant sector in Valencia's economy. He was a skilled diplomat and strategist, navigating the complex web of alliances and rivalries between the Kingdom of Aragon, the Catholic Church, and the nobility. This ability to build and maintain relationships allowed him to amass significant wealth and influence, earning him a place among the prominent business leaders of his time. His entrepreneurial spirit and business acumen paved the way for future generations of entrepreneurs in Valencia, leaving a lasting impact on the region's economic development.
